info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Business Direction Corporate Strategy-spec
info.description: The Corporate Strategy Creation API enables organizations to establish and manage their business direction by defining corporate strategies. It facilitates the integration of key strategic elements that guide decision-making and resource allocation within the enterprise. With this API, businesses can create new corporate strategies tailored to their goals and market conditions, making it essential for strategic planners and business analysts. Common use cases include formulating initiatives, aligning organizational objectives, and enhancing overall strategic alignment.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new corporate strategy for your business direction. Provide the necessary information in the request body to define the strategic objectives and initiatives that guide the company’s operations and resource allocation.

requestBody.description: Request body for creating or updating a corporate strategy within the business direction. The body must adhere to the specified schema and provide necessary details for the operation.
